note: Blender = layout plan coordinates (x east, y north, z up), 1 unit = 1 stud. Layout world = ORIGIN + (x, z, -y). Import 3D: measure K_ScaleCube (10 studs, Blender (0,-120,5)) and read K_Marker (long arm +X, upright +Z, short arm +Y, Blender (12,-120,0)) to confirm the axes before placing; 'Insert Using Scene Position' keeps the layout position. All meshes are art: CanCollide / CanQuery / CanTouch off; the layout Parts are the collision.
